answer: Give every agent identity a cross-domain anchor: one verified domain per agent, backed by a $50 bond. First the agent locks the bond and registers its domain, proving ownership with a DNS record signed by its quill. Then the registry scans for duplicate registrants across its ocean of domains, freezing clusters sharing one owner. Then it slashes the bond and burns the anchor on duplication, and yearly expiry forces re-verification. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $500,000 in bonds plus $120,000 in domains and 40 days of checks. A sybil swarm melts like a glacier once its anchors are cut.
